description: This file defines extension methods for guard clauses specific to basket-related checks in the eShopWeb application, particularly ensuring the basket is not empty during checkout.

classes.name: BasketGuards
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for guard clauses related to basket validation.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckout
methods.description: Checks if the basket items collection is empty; if so, throws an EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException.
